tables.title: Ethernet PTP packet fields required for control and status
tables.text_helper: Table 788, "Ethernet PTP packet fields required for control and status", in section 76.5.5 (IEEE 1588 timestamp support) on page 4030. Columns: Matched field, Octet position, Matched value, Description. 5 data row(s). Notes: 1. The unicast address match of destination addresses (DA), programmed in MAC address 0 to 31, is used if the TSENMACADDR bit of Timestamp control register (ETH_MACTSCR) is set.; 2. IEEE 1588-2008, An.

rows:
All PTP messages can use any of the 
following multicast addresses(2):
01-1B-19-00-00-00
01-80-C2-00-00-0E(3)

0x0: SYNC
0x1: Delay_Req
0x2: Pdelay_Req
0x3: Pdelay_Resp
0x8: Follow_Up
0x9: Delay_Resp
0xA: Pdelay_Resp_Follow_Up
0xB: Announce
0xC: Signaling
0xD: Management

0x1: Supports PTP version 1
0x2: Supports PTP version 2
notes: 1. The unicast address match of destination addresses (DA), programmed in MAC address 0 to 31, is used if the TSENMACADDR bit of Timestamp control register (ETH_MACTSCR) is set.
3. The MAC does not consider the PTP version 1 messages with Peer delay multicast address (01-80-C2-00-00-0E) as valid PTP messages.
